insurer: HDFC ERGO General Insurance Company Limited

great.name: PED waiting period (24 months) for pre-existing disability
great.quote: Any treatment for the pre-existing disability covered, will have a waiting period of 24 months from the first policy inception date.
great.reference: Section 6 (Specific Conditions Applicable for Persons with Disability)
great.explanation: Pre-existing disability is covered after 24 months of continuous coverage, which is better than many plans for the relevant covered condition.

good.name: PED waiting period (36 months) for other pre-existing diseases
good.quote: PED waiting period 36 months ( For pre existing diseases other than the pre-existing Disability and HIV/AIDS covered)
good.explanation: 3-year PED waiting is within normal market range (2–4 years) for standard health insurance.

good.name: Initial waiting period (30 days)
good.quote: First 30 days waiting period- Code- Excl03
good.explanation: 30-day initial waiting period for illnesses is standard (accidents are typically exempt).

good.name: Specific disease/procedure waiting period (24 months)
good.quote: Specified disease/procedure waiting period- Code- Excl02 ... excluded until the expiry of 24months
good.explanation: 24 months for listed specific conditions is industry-standard.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization cover (30 days)
good.quote: for a fixed period of 30 days prior to the date of admissible Hospitalization
good.explanation: Covers eligible medical expenses for 30 days before hospitalization, which is standard.

bad.name: Room rent limit (daily cap linked to Sum Insured) — 1% of Sum Insured per day
bad.quote: Room Rent, Boarding, Nursing Expenses as provided by the Hospital / Nursing Home up to maximum of 1% of the Sum Insured per day.
bad.explanation: Room rent is capped (not ‘any room / no limit’). This can restrict room choice and may lead to higher out-of-pocket if hospital room rates exceed the cap.

bad.name: Mandatory co-pay 20% on every claim (unless optional waiver is bought)
bad.quote: Each and every claim under the Policy shall be subject to a Co-payment of 20% ... This co-payment can be waived off by paying an additional premium(optional).
bad.explanation: By default you pay 20% of every admissible claim amount, which significantly reduces effective coverage unless you purchase the co-pay waiver.

bad.name: Disease sub-limit: Cataract capped at ₹40,000 per eye per year
bad.quote: subject to a limit of Rs.40,000/-, per each eye in one policy year.
bad.explanation: A fixed sub-limit for cataract can be inadequate in many hospitals and increases out-of-pocket costs.

bad.name: Modern treatments capped at 50% of Sum Insured
bad.quote: will be covered ... up to 50% of Sum Insured
bad.explanation: Many newer procedures are covered only up to 50% of SI, which can be limiting for expensive treatments.

bad.name: Consumables / non-payable items not covered (out-of-pocket)
bad.quote: Non-Payable items: The expenses that are not covered in this Policy are placed under List -I of Annexure-11
bad.reference: Section 8.2(17) and Annexure II (Non-Medical Expenses / List I)
bad.explanation: Consumables and many hospital items (e.g., gloves, masks, kits etc. listed as non-payable) are not covered, leading to routine out-of-pocket expenses.

bad.name: No restore benefit: Sum Insured is NOT replenished after a claim
bad.quote: Maximum liability of the Company under all such Claims paid under indemnity, during each Policy Year shall be the Sum Insured opted and specified in the Schedule.
bad.explanation: The document does not provide any ‘restore/reinstatement’ feature; once SI is exhausted in a policy year, coverage does not refill for further claims.

bad.name: Post-hospitalization cover limited to 60 days
bad.quote: for a fixed period of 60 days from the date of discharge from the Hospital
bad.explanation: 60 days is the minimum common level; many better policies cover 90/180/365 days. Longer follow-up expenses may not be covered.

unclear.name: NCB / Renewal Bonus not mentioned (verify if any bonus applies)
unclear.quote: Maximum liability of the Company under all such Claims paid under indemnity, during each Policy Year shall be the Sum Insured opted and specified in the Schedule.
unclear.reference: Section 2 (Operating Clause) / Table of Benefits (no NCB field shown)
unclear.explanation: No No-Claim Bonus/renewal bonus is explicitly described in the provided wording excerpt. Confirm from policy schedule/product brochure whether any SI increase/bonus exists and whether it resets on claim.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
